title: Front Office Receptionist
description:
Front Office Receptionist

**Company:** RD Hotel  
**Location:** Perundurai, Erode, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Front Office  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary:** Attractive salary for deserving candidates

Job Description

RD Hotel is looking for a friendly, professional, and customer-oriented Front Office Receptionist to join our team. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a pleasant personality, and the ability to provide excellent guest service while managing front office operations efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

* Welcome guests warmly and provide professional check-in and check-out services.
* Handle room reservations, walk-in bookings, cancellations, and booking modifications.
* Attend guest inquiries through phone calls, email, and in-person communication.
* Coordinate with housekeeping to ensure rooms are ready for guest arrivals.
* Maintain guest registration forms, ID proofs, room records, and other front office documents.
* Prepare guest bills, handle payments, and coordinate with the accounts team for billing-related matters.
* Manage bookings received through online travel agencies (OTAs) such as Booking.com, Agoda, and other platforms.
* Handle guest complaints and requests promptly and professionally.
* Coordinate with the restaurant, housekeeping, maintenance, and management teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Maintain accurate occupancy records, room status updates, and daily reports.
* Follow hotel policies, guest privacy requirements, and security procedures.

Requirements and Qualifications

* Minimum qualification: 12th Pass or any degree.
* Previous experience in hotel front office operations is preferred; freshers with good communication skills may also apply.
* Good verbal communication skills in Tamil and English.
* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Excel, email, and hotel billing software.
* Knowledge of hotel reservation systems and online booking portals will be an added advantage.
* Good customer service, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in shifts, including weekends and holidays.
* Well-groomed, punctual, responsible, and willing to learn.

What We Offer

* Attractive salary based on experience and skills.
* Opportunity to grow in the hospitality industry.
* Supportive working environment.
* Career development opportunities within the hotel group.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed or contact RD Hotel management for further details.

**Join RD Hotel and be part of a team committed to providing excellent hospitality and guest satisfaction.**

Pay: ₹13,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Leave encashment

Work Location: In person
